title: AI solves the Navier-Stokes equations in 88 hours

tellings.quote: The fact that it only took um 80 what was it? 88 hours to solve it. That stumped mathematicians for hundreds of years.

plain: Artificial intelligence solved the Navier-Stokes equations, the math that describes how fluids like air and water flow, in just 88 hours, according to an unnamed researcher who says so on the show. The researcher stresses that the problem had stumped mathematicians for hundreds of years. He brings it up in an episode arguing that AI may itself be a kind of alien technology, since it would be doing what humans could not.
